proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for calibre, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the calibre service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the calibre
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  calibre:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.calibre.loadbalancer.server.port=8080
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre.rule=Host(`calibre.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre.service=calibre
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.calibre.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.calibre.middlewares=authentik@docker
      # API paths stay open so client applications keep working.
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-api.rule=Host(`calibre.example.com`) && (PathPrefix(`/content-server`))
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-api.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-api.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-api.service=calibre
      - traefik.http.routers.calibre-api.priority=100

kubernetes:
# Calibre: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-calibre/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - security_opt seccomp=unconfined: For Docker Engine only, many modern gui apps need this to function as syscalls are unkown to Docker. (map to a seccompProfile or AppArmor annotation).
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: calibre-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: calibre-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: calibre
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: calibre
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/calibre:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: calibre-env
        ports:
        - name: port-8080
          containerPort: 8080
          protocol: TCP
        - name: port-8181
          containerPort: 8181
          protocol: TCP
        - name: port-8081
          containerPort: 8081
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: calibre-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: calibre-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: calibre-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: calibre
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: calibre
  ports:
  - name: port-8080
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
  - name: port-8181
    port: 8181
    targetPort: 8181
    protocol: TCP
  - name: port-8081
    port: 8081
    targetPort: 8081
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# calibre.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-calibre/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Calibre (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/calibre:latest
ContainerName=calibre
AutoUpdate=registry
# PodmanArgs=--security-opt seccomp=unconfined
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
# Environment=PASSWORD=
# Environment=CLI_ARGS=
Volume=/path/to/calibre/config:/config:Z
PublishPort=8080:8080
PublishPort=8181:8181
PublishPort=8081:8081
ShmSize=1gb

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
